activity_summary: At the lodging you thought of God locked into nine clauses like a tenant into a lease, and of a weaver who could not keep a sentence together and would be the happier man. You wrote none of it. The walk that put the thought in your head is not a place you stayed.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it once, and left the quire blank.

facets.activity: Thought of the nine clauses and a weaver

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: God locked into nine clauses, like a tenant into a lease.
